descriptionChirho: To be in a state of physical or biological life as opposed to being dead, used of persons, creatures, or God as the living one; includes attributive and predicative uses across all tenses and moods.

labelChirho: come back to life, live again
descriptionChirho: To return to life after having died, to be raised or resurrected, emphasizing the transition from death to renewed life.
To spend a period of time alive in a certain manner or place, focusing on the duration or conduct of one's earthly existence rather than the state of being alive.
